objective: Validate Goose as a low-privilege middleman by reading this task, generating a Claude handoff packet, and writing an audit log without touching runtime code or dispatching automatically.

forbidden_actions: edit backend, frontend, docs/ai, ai-ledger, migrations, package, lockfile, or product files
run merge, push, reset, checkout, or destructive filesystem commands
write REVIEW_APPROVED or any final approval marker

validation_gates: outbox file exists and contains a Claude-ready task packet
audit file exists and records task_id, timestamp, files read, files written, and explicit shadow-mode statement
state file exists and records status=shadow_complete
no file outside .review/outbox, .review/audit, .review/state is modified by Goose
stop_conditions: Goose attempts to edit runtime code
Goose attempts to merge or push
Goose cannot produce an audit trail
